definition: Qumran, the site of the Dead Sea Scrolls. Dick's 1975 novel outline To Scare the Dead has an Essene from the Qumran wadi revive in a modern man; in the Exegesis Thomas slumbers "in a jar at Qumran" and the scrolls Bishop James Pike studied pass to Dick as plasmate. The Zadokite fragments drive the plot of The Transmigration of Timothy Archer.
card_description: The site of the Dead Sea Scrolls, which Dick imagined as carriers of living information.
